# GulfCalc (gulfcalc.tech) — LLM Knowledge & API Manifest
> An unmetered, client-side financial, tax, and labor law utility platform engineered for expatriates, corporate counsel, and HR leaders across the 6 Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states.

Website: https://gulfcalc.tech
Repository: https://github.com/Sheharyar-ans/gulfcalc
Jurisdictions Covered: United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), State of Kuwait, State of Qatar, Sultanate of Oman, Kingdom of Bahrain.
Architecture: Static HTML5 / Vanilla JavaScript / Pure Client-Side Computation (Zero PII leaves browser).

---

## 1. Statutory Calculators & Direct Routes

### Kuwait Indemnity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-indemnity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law No. 6 of 2010 (Articles 51, 53 & 55).
- Statutory Daily Wage Divisor: Mandatory 26 working days (Article 55: Daily Wage = Monthly Remuneration / 26).
- Accrual Scale: 15 working days per year for years 1-5; 30 working days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 1.5 years' remuneration (18 months of monthly salary).
- Resignation Deductions (Article 53): 0% (<3 yrs); 50% (3-5 yrs); 66.67% (5-10 yrs); 100% (10+ yrs).

### Saudi End of Service Award (EOSA) Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-end-of-service-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Saudi Labour Law (Royal Decree No. M/51), Articles 84, 85, 86, 87.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Actual Wage (Basic Salary + Fixed Housing Allowance + Fixed Transport Allowance).
- Accrual Scale: 15 days (half month) per year for first 5 years; 30 days (full month) per year thereafter.
- Resignation Deductions (Article 85): 0% (<2 yrs); 33.33% (2-5 yrs); 66.67% (5-10 yrs); 100% (10+ yrs).
- Article 87 Exceptions: Full 100% award payable upon female resignation within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of childbirth, force majeure, or employer default under Article 81.

### UAE End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (Article 51).
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage (excludes allowances).
- Accrual Scale: 21 calendar days per year for years 1-5; 30 calendar days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 2 years' basic salary (24 months of basic wage).
- Harmonized Resignation: 100% identical entitlement for resignation and employer termination once 1 continuous year is completed.

### Qatar End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/qatar-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Qatar Labour Law No. 14 of 2004 (Article 54) & Ministry of Labour Guidelines.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage.
- Statutory Minimum Accrual: Minimum 21 calendar days (3 weeks) per completed year of service.
- Fractional Tenure: Exact pro-rata calculation for partial months and days.
- Resignation Treatment: Full entitlement payable upon completion of 1 year.

### Oman End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/oman-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Oman Labour Law under Royal Decree No. 53/2023 (Article 61).
- Statutory Accrual: Flat 30 days (1 full month's basic wage) for every completed year of service starting from year one.
- Legacy Transition Engine: Accommodates repealed RD 35/2003 (15 days for first 3 years, 30 days thereafter) for pre-July 2023 tenures.

### Bahrain End of Service Indemnity (EOSI) & VAT Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/bahrain-eosi-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Bahrain Labour Law for Private Sector (Law No. 36 of 2012, Article 116).
- Statutory Accrual: 15 days' wage per year for years 1-3; 30 days (one month) per year for year 4 onwards.
- SIO Expat Accruals: Aligned with 2024 Social Insurance Organisation deposit regulations.
- VAT Module: 10% standard Bahrain VAT addition and extraction calculation engine.

### UAE Corporate Tax Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-corporate-tax-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses.
- Statutory Rates: 0% on net taxable profits up to AED 375,000; 9% on net taxable profits exceeding AED 375,000.
- Small Business Relief (SBR): Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023 relief election for resident taxable businesses with gross annual turnover <= AED 3,000,000.

### GCC Remittance True Cost Engine
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-remittance-fee-calculator.html
- Purpose: Unmasks hidden foreign exchange markups embedded by exchange houses and banks.
- Formula: True Drag = Upfront Flat Fee + (Send Amount * FX Markup Spread %).
- Corridors: Origin (AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD) to Destination (INR, PKR, PHP, BDT, EGP).
